name: genpark-agentic-webhook-signature-verifier-skill
description: Universal Agentic Webhook Signature Verifier & Ingress Multiplexer. Authenticates multi-provider webhooks (Shopify, Stripe, GitHub, Slack, PayPal) with HMAC-SHA256 constant-time verification, timestamp replay window validation, and multiplexed agent event dispatch.

tools.name: verify_and_route_webhook
tools.description: Verify webhook signature authenticity (HMAC-SHA256), prevent replay attacks with timestamp windows, and route verified event payloads to designated subagents.

timestamp_header.description: Optional timestamp string from header for replay check.
